title: elymus cylindricus
intro: Elymus cylindricus, commonly known as Wild Elymus, is a perennial grass native to the mountainous regions of China. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Elymus cylindricus include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Wild Elymus include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, as well as its ability to improve immune function and reduce oxidative stress.
